newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympus 97/98 current profit seen up 50 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: Olympus 97/98 current profit seen up 50 pct-paper.

text.p: Olympus Optical Co Ltd's parent current profit is expected to rise to about nine billion yen in the year to next March 31, up 50 percent from its estimated profit in 1996/97, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected increase was due to the yen's fall and an expected rise in sales of endoscopes. The paper said its forecast is based on its assumption that the dollar will average 120 yen in 1997/98.
Olympus was not immediately available for comment on the report.
The company said in November it expected to post a parent current profit of six billion yen in 1996/97 against its 1995/96 actual parent current profit of 4.90 billion yen.
